en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large historicist building with steep tiled roofs and ornate gables. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stand in front of the arched entrance. Printed German captions identify it as the new post and telegraph office in Hermannstadt. The left margin lists the publisher, and a handwritten message runs vertically on the right side. The reverse side has Hungarian text, a green "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" 5‑fillér stamp, postal cancellations, and the printed heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP."
